entries.zh: 御；帝王御用之物，属君王所有
entries.en: royal; imperial — a thing pertaining to the king

entries.zh: 阵势；军阵列阵布防之形势
entries.en: battle array; troops drawn up in order of war
a real in money — the real (Spanish silver coin) reckoned as currency
entries.notes: 中文侧无法定夺：H 字形存疑（戔/友）、M 音写存疑（quar/quan）、R 空栏；西语侧为货币单位 real 之义，中文对应阙如。

entries.zh: 瓣；瓜果之瓣、如瓜瓣之切片
entries.en: a slice, as of a melon; segment
to cut it in slices; to slice it off
entries.notes: 首字声调号污損（T99），按低置信规则降级；批截之义明晰。

entries.en: a flock or herd of animals; drove
entries.notes: H/M/R 三栏皆 [空]，中文释义无据，仅据西语词头 Rebaño q manada 得义。

entries.en: to quarrel and snatch away; contention
entries.notes: 首音节声调号污損（T99）且原稿有删改（cheng 被删）；义据争字明晰，按低置信规则降级。

entries.en: to snatch; to seize or rob forcibly
to seize from one another; mutual contention
to seize and plunder from one another
to rebel; to rise against authority

entries.notes: 第二字声调号污損（T99），按低置信规则降级；反逆之义明晰。

entries.zh: 激变；属下（藩属）激变、民变作乱
entries.en: a sudden revolt of vassals/subjects; uprising

entries.zh: 墙垣外之棱堡、城墙缺口（三川隙）
entries.en: a ravelin (outwork) of the wall; possibly a breach or gap in the rampart
entries.notes: M 栏第三音节残缺（qu[残]）兼两处声调号污損（T99）；三川隙与 revellín（棱堡）/缺口之对应存疑。
